payload.description: Implement story plx-48b1ee as a provider-neutral application service and durable repository contract with executable behavior specifications. Cover tenant scoping, structured submission, service-owned identity/time, idempotent duplicate submission, idempotency conflicts, status lookup, cancellation state, and atomic dispatch discoverability. Do not add HTTP, AWS, Kubernetes, dashboard, Celery, or provider storage implementations.
payload.title: Implement the portable command service contract
